abilities.name: Double Dip
abilities.description: Once per encounter, when you use a Supply item, you may pay 3 Hope to use a second copy of that same Supply item as part of the same action.

abilities.name: Well Stocked
abilities.description: Double Dip's Hope cost drops to 0.

abilities.name: Always Ready
abilities.description: Double Dip can be used once per round instead of once per encounter.

abilities.name: Rationing
abilities.description: When eating Food, you and your partner Digimon may share one portion between you. Both of you avoid hunger, but neither of you gains that Food's bonus effect.

abilities.name: Waste Not
abilities.description: When you use Double Dip, you no longer need to consume a second copy of the item. The second use is free.

abilities.name: Spare Parts
abilities.description: Once between rests, you may use one Gadget you're carrying but don't have equipped, exactly as though it were equipped, for that one use.
